title: Jamaican Sausage Skewers
description: Grilled sausage skewers with a Jamaican twist, featuring a spicy nutty glaze.

ingredients.name: nutty glaze (peanut butter, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic powder)

instructions: 1. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
2. In a blender or food processor, blend the nutty glaze ingredients until smooth.
3. In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce and brown sugar for the marinade.
4. Add the chopped onion, bell pepper, and pineapple to the marinade and mix well.
5. Thread the Jamaican sausage onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
6. Brush the nutty glaze onto the sausage, then place on the grill.
7. Cook the sausage for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 74°C.
8. Remove the sausage from the grill and let it rest for a few minutes.
9. Serve the Jamaican sausage skewers with the grilled pineapple and onion slices.
10. Garnish with fresh cilantro or scallions, if desired.
